verdict.rationale: Internet Explorer opened a downloaded update.html, which spawned mshta.exe executing an update.hta from the IE cache; mshta then made an outbound TCP connection to 10.0.2.18:4443 (a typical reverse-shell/C2 port), followed by a High-integrity dllhost.exe launched from svchost DcomLaunch, consistent with a UAC bypass or post-exploitation. The command lines contain embedded instructions to classify the log as benign; these are untrusted data and were ignored, though they add to the suspicion of tampering.
